# 3A Technology Solutions

> Nigerian software studio and training academy building web applications, custom business software, AI tools, data systems, and brand identities, while teaching practical tech skills through 3A Techvolution Academy.

## Commercial Services
- [Commercial Services Overview](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services): Overview of our five commercial services for SMEs, startups, and institutions in Nigeria.
- [Web & Digital Products](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/web-development): Fast, mobile-friendly company websites, customer portals, and web applications built with React and Next.js.
- [Custom Software Engineering](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/custom-software): Internal business tools, digital logbooks, REST APIs, and database systems built around how your team works.
- [AI & Automation](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/ai-automation): Practical AI assistants, document readers, and automated workflows that cut down repetitive manual tasks.
- [Data Science & Analytics](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/data-science-analytics): Reporting dashboards, forecasting models, data cleaning pipelines, and computer vision systems.
- [Branding & Digital Media](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/brand-digital-media): Logo systems, brand style guides, pitch decks, and digital templates for a consistent visual identity.

## 3A Techvolution Academy
- [Academy Overview](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy): Hands-on technology courses where students, NYSC members, and career switchers learn by building real software projects.
- [Academy Programmes & Tracks](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/programmes): Course breakdowns for Practical Software Engineering (12 weeks), Applied AI & Automation (8 weeks), and Data Science & Machine Learning (10 weeks).

## Projects & Company Info
- [Projects & Case Studies](https://3atechnology.com.ng/projects): Filterable catalog of live software, working prototypes, and research projects across web, custom software, AI, and computer vision.
- [About 3A Technology Solutions](https://3atechnology.com.ng/about): Our brand foundation ("Technology that works for people and business"), five brand pillars, and CAC registration details.
- [Request a Project Quote](https://3atechnology.com.ng/request-quote): Project intake form to scope web, software, AI, or data work and get a response within one business day.
- [Contact Us](https://3atechnology.com.ng/contact): Direct email, WhatsApp contact links, and office locations for clients and prospective students.
